messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to update SDK streaming/pagination snippets across py/ts/go. Need quick check for API surface rename (retry_policy -> retries) and cursor shape change (cursor -> next_cursor).

maria: Thanks. Can you link the PR? I want to update the Python example in quickstart.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — top-level change: streaming now yields an async iterator (Python: `async for token in stream.generate(...)`), TS: `for await (const token of stream.generate(...))`, Go: `for { tok, err := stream.Next(ctx); ... }`. Also changed the backpressure example to use client-side batching.

jordan: Noted. For pagination, we introduced `page_token` -> `cursor_token` and responses now return `next_cursor` (not `cursor`). Also rename retry param as you said. Docs snippets must reflect both shapes.

sam: I updated the TypeScript snippet in the PR to use `retries: { attempts: 3 }` instead of `retry_policy`. Want me to push patch for Go and Py too?

maria: Yes — please. For Python, the new async interface looks like this:

```python
async for chunk in client.stream.generate(
    model="rwd-1-stream",
    prompt="Summarize...",
    retries={"attempts": 2},
):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

maria: Also add a one-line note about `StreamError` being raised for terminal stream errors, users should catch it around the iterator.

alex: Good call. Example for error handling:

```python
try:
    async for tok in client.stream.generate(...):
        process(tok)
except StreamError as e:
    logger.error("stream failed", exc_info=e)
    # fallback to sync generation or retry strategy
```

jordan: For Go, sample should show the `stream.Next(ctx)` loop and handle `io.EOF` vs errors. I'll draft and push to the PR (will include small snippet and comment about context cancelation).

ci-bot: build/docs: linkcheck failed on `examples/old-pagination.md` (404) — see CI details: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1234

sam: I'll fix that link (old -> examples/pagination-migration.md) and re-run linkcheck.

maria: One more small request: update the SDK reference table that lists `supports_streaming` for each model — add a note for quantized variants that streaming may be slower.

alex: OK I'll merge after CI is green and we have +2 approvals. Assigning reviewers @maria and @jordan. :thumbsup:

sam: On it, will push Go + Py snippet patches in the next hour.

maria: Thanks — will review once patches arrive.
